ErrorUnsupportedFormat: This audio format is not supported.

ErrorYouTubeSearch: YouTube search failed. Check the connection and try again.
ErrorYouTubeVideoUnavailable: YouTube will not provide this video. It may be removed, region-restricted, or require sign-in. Try another result.
ErrorYouTubeVideoUnplayable: YouTube cannot play this video here. Try another result.
ErrorYouTubeSignIn: YouTube requires sign-in verification for this network. MusicMixer tried cookies from your default browser, but the browser keeps its cookie database locked while running. Fully quit Edge/Chrome/Brave, including background processes, make sure you are signed in to YouTube there, then retry. You can also set MUSICMIXER_YTDLP_COOKIES or MUSICMIXER_YTDLP_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER.
ErrorYouTubeCookiesFile: The selected cookies file could not be used. Export youtube.com cookies in Netscape format and choose the file again.
ErrorYouTubeNoAudio: This video has no usable audio stream. Try another result.
ErrorYouTubeDownload: The audio download failed. Check the connection and try again.
ErrorYouTubeConversion: The audio was downloaded, but FFmpeg could not convert it. Check the FFmpeg installation.
ErrorYouTubeMemory: Not enough memory to process this video. Try a shorter one.
ErrorYouTubeRegion: YouTube integration is unavailable in this region.
